units.source_text: 你試著畫幾幅怎麼樣？我可以跟我們雜誌社的主編說一聲。」

en.t: Why not try drawing a few? I could put in a word with the editor in chief at our magazine.

units.source_text: 這家雜誌社發行的主要是面向兒童，沒什麼知名度的月刊雜誌。

en.t: The magazine company mainly published a little known monthly magazine for children.

units.source_text: 「……看到你，大部分女人都會想為你做點什麼。

en.t: When they see you, most women want to do something for you.

units.source_text: ……你總是一副戰戰兢兢的樣子，卻又是一個滑稽幽默家。

en.t: You always seem timid and frightened, yet at the same time you are a comic humorist.

units.source_text: ……雖然有時獨自一人，鬱鬱寡歡，但正是這一點，才更讓女人為之心動。」

en.t: Sometimes you sit alone and look terribly depressed, but that very thing makes women feel even more drawn to you.

units.source_text: 靜子說了很多恭維我的話，可一想到她說的都是小白臉的卑劣特徵，

en.t: Shizuko said many flattering things about me, but when I thought that everything she described was really a vile trait of a kept man,

units.source_text: 我就愈發消沉，提不起精神。

en.t: I sank even deeper into gloom and could not summon any energy.

units.source_text: 我暗中盤算著金錢比女人重要，想逃離靜子，獨自生活。

en.t: In secret I was calculating that money mattered more than women, and I wanted to escape from Shizuko and live on my own.
